title: Assembling quotient algebraizations into a principal-complete model
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $I\subseteq A$ an ideal, and $P=\widehat{A[x_1,\ldots,x_r]}_I$ for $r\geq0$ [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring, def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. Let $J\subseteq P$ be an ideal and put $E=P/J$, assumed $I$-adically complete. Suppose some $c\geq0$ satisfies $I^c\ker\delta=I^c\operatorname{coker}\delta=0$, where $\delta:J/J^2\to E^{\oplus r}$ sends $f\bmod J^2$ to $(\partial f/\partial x_i\bmod J)_i$, using continuous polynomial derivatives. Write $I=K+(a)$ with $K\subseteq A$ an ideal and $a\in A$. For every $m\geq1$ put $A_m=A/(a^m)$ and $K_m=KA_m$. Assume that for each $m$ there is a finite type commutative $A_m$-algebra $C_m$ [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra] such that $\operatorname{Spec}C_m\to\operatorname{Spec}A_m$ is etale over $\operatorname{Spec}A_m\setminus V(K_m)$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum, def-weil-etale-morphism] and $\widehat{C_m}_{K_m}\cong E/a^mE$ as $A_m$-algebras. No compatibility between these choices is assumed. Then there are a commutative $(a)$-adically complete $A$-algebra $F$, an $A$-algebra map $u:F\to E$ whose induced map $\widehat F_I\to E$ is an isomorphism, and a presentation $F\cong\widehat{A[z_1,\ldots,z_q]}_{(a)}/Q$ for some finite $q\geq0$ and ideal $Q$. For this presentation some $a^e$, $e\geq0$, annihilates both kernel and cokernel of $Q/Q^2\to F^{\oplus q}$, $h\mapsto(\partial h/\partial z_j)_j$.

proof.text: For each $m$, the stipulated isomorphism $\widehat{C_m}_{K_m}\cong E/a^mE$ makes $E_m=E/a^mE$ complete: apply [lem-weil-pbc-module-completion-complete] to the $A_m$-module $C_m$. The ideal $K_m$ is finitely generated, being the image of the finitely generated ideal $K$ in the Noetherian ring $A$. Apply [lem-per-rig-etale-compatible-model-tower] to replace these independently chosen models by models, still denoted $C_m$, with maps $v_m:C_m\to E_m$ and transition isomorphisms $C_m/a^{m-1}C_m\cong C_{m-1}$. The $v_m$ commute with reduction to $E_{m-1}$. This is the compatibility construction, not a consequence of two completions being isomorphic.

Apply [lem-per-rig-etale-principal-tower-limit] to this tower and put $F=\varprojlim_m C_m$. It is $(a)$-adically complete and Noetherian, its projections identify $F/a^mF$ with $C_m$, and it has an $A$-algebra presentation $F\cong\widehat{A[z_1,\ldots,z_q]}_{(a)}/Q$ with $q$ finite. We retain these projection-induced identifications throughout.

source.place: Tag 0AKA, paragraph beginning “By construction”; Tags 0AJP and 0AJQ.

proof.text: We construct the required map and completion comparison using finite quotients. Fix $n\geq1$. In $A_n=A/(a^n)$ put $T_n=IA_n=K_n+(\bar a)$. Since $\bar a^n=0$, $K_n^j\subseteq T_n^j$ and $T_n^{j+n-1}\subseteq K_n^j$ for every $j\geq1$: in each monomial either at least $j$ factors lie in $K_n$, or at least $n$ factors are $\bar a$. Thus $K_n$ and $T_n$ define cofinal filtrations on $C_n$. Restriction to cofinal quotients identifies their inverse limits, by sending a compatible sequence to the same residue classes in each quotient. Hence $v_n$ identifies $\widehat{C_n}_{T_n}$ with $E_n$. By [lem-weil-pbc-module-completion-complete] for the finitely generated ideal $T_n$, this gives $C_n/T_n^nC_n\cong E_n/T_n^nE_n$. Since $a^n\in I^n$, the projection of Step 2 identifies the left side with $F/I^nF$ and the right side is $E/I^nE$. The resulting isomorphism is induced by $F\to C_n\xrightarrow{v_n}E_n\to E/I^nE$.

source.place: Tag 0AKA, completion comparison following the inverse-limit construction; algebra.tex Tag 05GG.

proof.text: The isomorphisms $\theta_n:F/I^nF\to E/I^nE$ of Step 3 commute with all reductions: for $m\geq n$, the square follows from $C_m\to C_n$ commuting with $v_m,v_n$ and $E_m\to E_n$ in Step 1. Thus their inverse limit $\widehat F_I\to\varprojlim_n E/I^nE=E$ is an $A$-algebra isomorphism, with inverse given by the sequence of the $\theta_n^{-1}$. Define $u:F\to E$ as the completion map followed by this isomorphism. The map induced by $u$ on the $n$th quotient is exactly $\theta_n$, so its induced completion map is exactly the isomorphism just constructed.

source.place: Tag 0AKA, assertion that the I-adic completion of B-prime is B, expanded on quotient maps.

proof.text: The original $E$ has finite type special fibre over $A/I$. Indeed [lem-weil-pbc-module-completion-complete] identifies $P/IP$ with $(A/I)[x_1,\ldots,x_r]$; its surjection onto $E/IE$ exhibits that ring as a quotient of this polynomial ring. We may therefore apply condition (i) implies (ii) of [lem-per-rig-etale-principal-tower-conormal-transfer] to $B=E$ and $H=I$, using the assumed annihilation of the original differential. There is a single integer $d$ such that, for every $m$, $I^d$ annihilates the two cohomology modules of $N_{K_m}(E_m/A_m)$. Here take $L=(a^m)$ and $H_0=K_m$. Their required vanishing loci agree because $a$ is nilpotent in $A_m$: every prime contains its image, so it contains $IA_m=K_m+(\bar a)$ exactly when it contains $K_m$. The exponent $d$ is chosen before $m$.

source.place: Tag 0AKA, uniform cohomology bound; Tags 0AJU and 0AK2.

proof.text: For each $m$ choose a finite polynomial presentation $\alpha_m:A_m[y_1,\ldots,y_{s_m}]\twoheadrightarrow C_m$ with kernel $T_m$, and put $M_{1,m}=\ker d_{\alpha_m}$, $M_{0,m}=\operatorname{coker}d_{\alpha_m}$. The base $A_m$ is Noetherian by [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra-noetherian], since it is a quotient of $A$. Apply [lem-per-etale-supported-cotangent-completion]: both $M_{i,m}$ are finite and killed by some power $K_m^{b_m}$. Thus $M_{i,m}\to\widehat M_{i,m}$ is an isomorphism: its quotient sequence is constant from $b_m$ onward. Now [lem-per-completed-jacobian-homology-comparison], applied to $\alpha_m$ and any completed presentation of $E_m=\widehat{C_m}_{K_m}$, gives $E_m$-linear isomorphisms from these completed modules onto the two completed conormal cohomology modules of $E_m/A_m$. Step 5 therefore gives $I^dM_{i,m}=0$, and in particular $a^dM_{i,m}=0$, for every $m$. The possibly varying exponents $b_m$ are used only for the individual completion isomorphisms; the common exponent $d$ comes from Step 5.

Apply condition (iii) implies (i) of [lem-per-rig-etale-principal-tower-conormal-transfer] to $B=F$ and $H=(a)$. Step 2 supplies completeness, finite type special fibre, and the chosen finite completed polynomial presentation. Its quotients are $F/a^mF=C_m$ over $A/(a^m)=A_m$. The polynomial presentations and common exponent $d$ of Step 6 give exactly condition (iii), including its independence of $m$. Thus some $a^e$ annihilates the kernel and cokernel of $Q/Q^2\to F^{\oplus q}$ for the presentation of Step 2. With $F$ and $u$ from Steps 2 and 4, this proves every assertion.

Step 2 is the tower limit (0AJP+0AJQ); I checked it for a=0 and a a unit. Step 3: the cofinality T^{j+n-1}⊆K^j is elementary, then 05GG(2) and a^n∈I^n give F/I^n≅E/I^n. Step 4 is the commuting limit. Step 5 uses transfer (i)⇒(ii) with L=(a^m), H_0=K_m; V agree because ā is nilpotent. (ii) is true because 0AJU(3)⇒(2) gives one c with I^c zero in D(B), and 0AK2 with remark-take-bar carries it to every quotient; this is a uniform strengthening of jacobian-torsion-closed-base-change, not a duplicate. Step 6: the supported-cotangent node (true: finite modules supported on V(HC)) gives M=\hat M, then homology-comparison with I:=K_m gives a^d M=0 for all m. Step 7 is transfer (iii)⇒(i), i.e. 0AJU(4)⇒(3), with H=(a). There is no cycle and no SGA. The DAG grep for 0AJP/0AJU/0AK2/0AKA-related nodes and tower limits found no duplicates.
